messages:
Tasha: quick heads-up	7: we shipped GA last night. Need a short sync on iteration plan: triage bugs vs enhancements and finalize acceptance gates for next mini-cycle.
Leo: congrats team. We should enforce two launch criteria before touching enhancements: 1) P0/P1 regressions fixed, 2) telemetry for key flows shows p99 latency within SLO for 72h.
Maria: agree. Also want a policy for customer-driven asks: if >3 paying customers request the same small enhancement with clear ROI, we can bump it into the next sprint. Otherwise it goes to backlog grooming.
Sam: proposal: split the follow-on into two lanes: "stability" (bugs/regressions/security) and "velocity" (small enhancements, UX polish). Each lane gets one engineer pair per sprint.
Jin: practical ask	7: can we define "small enhancement" as <= 3 story points + no infra work? Saves negotiation time.
Tasha: yes. add rule: safety net for experiments - any change touching runtime or batching must have an explicit rollback and perf test in CI.
Leo: on backlog grooming cadence: weekly quick groom for small enhancements (15m) and bi-weekly deep groom for stability tickets (45m). Assign owners for each ticket during groom.
Maria: customer-priority flow: CS flags a request, product triages with eng within 24h, if it meets the >3-paying-customer rule or is P1 impact, we route to "expedite" and schedule a scoping session.
Sam: operational checklist for hotfix vs mini-epic: hotfix if fix <1 day and affects revenue/SLA; mini-epic if cross-team or needs >3 days.
product-bot: created epic draft "chat-stability-q4" and assigned draft owner @sam at 2024-11-05T10:02:00Z
Jin: risk note: aggressive batching changes can change embedding outputs slightly. Add an eval gate comparing top-N embedding distances on canary before promote.
Tasha: action items: 1) Sam to publish mini-cycle plan with lanes and owners by EOD, 2) Maria to write acceptance gates for GA->post-GA on the product wiki, 3) Jin to add embedding eval gate to CI.
Maria: thanks. We'll follow up in grooming tomorrow 10:15 PST. Keep backlog tidy and mark any customer-asked items with `cs-priority` tag.
Sam: will do. I'll also prepare a small decision doc for tradeoffs (cost vs latency vs correctness) to help negotiations with sales.
Tasha: wrap	7: for now: no new enhancements promoted until stability lane meets the 72h telemetry SLO.
Maria: thumbs up. Good work team.
